objective: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.
start: Dropped by Silithid Harvester in The Barrens

description: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
progress: You seemed troubled, <name>. How go your lessons in the Barrens? Did you find something that disturbs you?
completion: I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens. I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...
But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.
